speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong
text: asked	the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources whether the Ministry will consider having water rationing exercises twice a year to instil in our citizens and residents the importance of water and inculcate responsible water usage behaviour in view of the persistent drought and diminishing water levels in Linggiu Reservoir.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Encouraging prudent use of water is an important thrust of our effort.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We believe that good habits are best cultivated when young.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Our aim is to reinforce the value of water among our students, starting from young, and inculcate the habit of saving water early.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We plan to do this again and we encourage more schools and other organisations to join us next year.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: It also devised a "Time to Save" programme where primary school students learn and practise water conservation.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Moving forward, PUB will be carrying out studies to gain a deeper understanding of households' water usage patterns so as to better design and implement outreach programmes.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Through these plans, businesses can better understand their water usage and establish water management systems to enhance their water efficiency.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: All of us have to do our part to conserve water.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: This way, our water resources can last longer.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Every effort counts and, collectively, the amount of water saved can be significant.
